steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What is it, Ermi?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: How's your progress after two days?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I've found lots of them! ...Well, okay, just two, actually... But don't you worry, I'll have it all wrapped up in no time! Why, what's the matter?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nothing, really. The old man suddenly remembered this little mission of yours, so he's been pestering me about it.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: We thought these fragments would be causing chaos all over Kazdel, but for the time being, things still seem normal as ever.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nobody's knocking on the Military Commission's door about it, and we haven't detected any abnormalities either.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (*whispers*) All thanks to me being the first to run into them, haha...

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Basically, feel free to keep going at your own pace.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Is that all?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Yep, that's all. Just remember, safety first. If you run into anything you can't handle, give me a call.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sure, will do. Thanks, Ermi.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi's thoughtful as ever, even while she works. I should probably pick up the pace.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: So, whaddya want to eat?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? Oh, sorry, let me have a look.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'll try this one.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Is this a new recipe?

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Just baked dough, same as always. Pretty sure I've seen you eat here before, too.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But the taste is different, no?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's chewier than last time. Maybe even a little bit... sweet?

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Really? Maybe my ingredients are better this time around.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: More and more folks have been coming back lately, and I got ways to get quality stuff at a lower price. Dough gets nicer, that's a bonus.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Then, do you still need my help negotiating prices?

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Nah, an old merc customer of mine put me in touch with a better supplier. They've got reasonable prices, and they're a friendly bunch. No need to trouble yourself any longer.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Happy to hear that! Does this mean one day, you could make white bread like they do in Victoria?

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: You little glutton, what's so great about white bread? Next time you've got time, I'll cook you up some grilled meat.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Really?! Mmm, grilled meat...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Can I have three more buns of the dough to go? I'll eat them on the road.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Sure. Just wait a sec and I'll give you some fresh out the oven.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hehe, thank you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hmm-hmm. I've gotten so much done over the last two days, I think I deserve a little treat for myself.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Nothing beats a full belly—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hmm?
Nymph glimpses a Sarkaz out the corner of her eye. Not on purpose, of course.
Any passerby would find themselves turning their head. It would be hard not to.
She stands motionless, leaning against her cane, with her top-hatted head held high.
Here, where most are disheveled and scruffy-looking, a woman like her is a rare sight indeed.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Here, your dough.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? Oh, thanks...

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: First time laying eyes on her?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I don't think I've ever seen anyone quite like... her.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: She wasn't always this way. Not sure when she went mad. Left Kazdel to make a name for herself, came back looking like this.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh... Well, even so, she does look pretty nice.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: What's the point of looking nice? Can't sell a thing if you just stand there all day.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She sells baked dough too?

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: As if. She makes jewelry out of garbage.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Some odd gewgaws too, like a transparent glass witchcraft orb with a model of Kazdel inside, or cups etched with strange patterns. It's all expensive, fragile stuff. Only a fool would buy any of it.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Heard she's got ornaments and statues on top of all that. Even less business on those. Can't get any use out of them most days, and so expensive too. Don't know what she's thinking.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Everyone around has been telling her, but she won't listen to a word of it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ahaha...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I don't think it's a bad thing, getting to see someone dressed up so pretty on the street every day.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: I just hope she earns enough to feed herself... It'd be some terrible joke if she starved to death in front of my stall, right?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hmm, I see where you're coming from... I'd better get going, see you.

steps.name: Street Hawker
steps.text: Be seeing you, Nymph. Bring some friends next time.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I will! Bye-bye!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *phew*... Now that I'm full, I should get back to work.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (She's so pretty...)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (Is that how they dress in Victoria? Those fabrics look really expensive.)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (And there's that brooch of hers with those purple and red gems...)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (Once I'm done with this job and I get my reward from Ermi, I'll go have a look at her stall!)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, there's one here?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No way, there was no response just a moment ago.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Where is it, then?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That brooch with the purple and red gems...?
Nymph feels a sudden tickle up her spine. She turns to look at the stall devoid of customers.
But no one is there. The behatted stall owner has long since packed up her wares and disappeared into the endless stream of people flowing through Kazdel.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi, please pick up, it's urgent.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What now...?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: If she's only wearing all that jewelry because she's possessed, then she...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: There's no time. I'll go looking for her first.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hello, do you know where the lady who runs this stall went off to? The one wearing a suit and top hat—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Huh? A suit of what? Uh... She's wearing really strange clothes, and selling stuff no one wants to buy!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She went that way? Okay, thank y—The baked dough?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I got it from the stall over on the corner. Here, have some. If you like it, make sure you go to that stall!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm almost out of the city at this point. What did she come here for?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What's the detector say...? A very weak reaction, but it's here, alright.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'll just have to check over everything.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's here.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: A warehouse?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She lives here?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No way, why would someone wearing such nice clothes live here?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Maybe it's because of... the revenant fragment?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I can't reach Ermi, and Pohl's looking for fragments somewhere else.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: C'mon, Nymph, think, think! There's got to be a way!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hypnosis, mental suggestion, Originium Arts... Maybe I could snatch it away?!
Hello, young lady. Did you need me for something?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry, let me think a bit longer...
Very good, ma'am.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: H-Hello?
Crownie Mantel, Elegance Extraordinaire. A pleasure to meet you. Now, how may I be of service?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Could you sell me that brooch?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Because, because...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Because I really like it!

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Well, I'm terribly sorry, ma'am, but it is not for sale.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Moreover, I'm afraid it's not suited to your ensemble.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I have here an adornment much more appropriate for a rose such as yourself. If your need is dire, I could give it to you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry, I'm only interested in the brooch.
Nymph looks into Crownie's eyes. Her arms hang by her sides as her fingers sway lightly at an unusual frequency, tracing complex patterns in the air.
They are reflected in Crownie's pupils, but as she blinks, they are gently wiped away. It seems they have not dug deep into her heart as Nymph expected.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I'm afraid that's not possible.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I will not part with this gem before finding a suitable replacement.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Now, I have some pressing business to attend to, so I'm afraid I cannot entertain you any longer. On your way now.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (Waves staff)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (Chants softly)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Please wait a moment, and hear my plea.
Nymph projects her Arts with all her will, and they descend gently upon Crownie.
One second, two...
Her target continues to walk away.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: ...No effect?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She's wearing the fragment. Getting around the revenant's influence on her sure isn't easy.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: This is a really stupid way to do it, but...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Forgive me, Madam Djall, but I'm in a hurry. Please don't block my way.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi, please, please, please answer.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Arts don't work, I can't fight her, and I can't snatch it away.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She's no normal hawker!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Just follow her for now, Nymph. Let's see where our ancestor wants to take her.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Even if something happens, I can at least give more info to Ermi.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's not like she's going to go all the way out of the city, right?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: We're on the outskirts already. Where's she going?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Maybe she really is leaving the city?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I should contact the Liches at the gates, then. Ermi gave me their info. They should be able to get the fragment for me.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? Where'd she go?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, what?!
Nymph watches as Crownie opens her own box, drawing out a hang glider from the depths within.
One hand grips the cane hooked onto the glider's frame, while the other holds the box tight. With her characteristic ramrod-straight figure dangling from the glider, she swoops off into the distance.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Can a revenant fragment really do all that?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I guess I should...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Forget it, Ermi's being awfully unreliable right now.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, how about I...?
Nymph hems and haws for a while as she watches the glider float away, but in the end, she makes up her mind.
She inserts the tip of her key into the keyhole on her staff. It breaks apart, turning into a swarm of keys surrounding her.
She grabs one and opens the bag at her waist, the keys immediately splitting into two groups as she does so.
One flock of keys attaches to her staff, rapidly spinning like a drone's rotor wing.
The others act as platforms under Nymph's feet, holding her aloft despite gravity's pull.
Standing in midair is an extremely strange experience.
Drifting off wherever the wind blows, watching the familiar sights behind slowly shrink away.
Until the jagged edges of Kazdel have faded into fuzziness under the gentle light of the sun.
Then, with the breeze in back and the wind ahead—
A moment's distraction means tumbling to the ground.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: AHHHHHH!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hah... Hah...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Here. Use my handkerchief to wipe your sweat.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ah... Th-Thanks...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I must admit, I have never seen anyone act quite so recklessly. You are inexperienced with those Arts, are you not?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Y... Yes...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: If you hadn't flown by to catch me, I'd be a big splat on the ground.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Thank you for the hanky.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Oh, don't mention it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Do you always use your glider to leave the city?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: It's quick, convenient and graceful. A most beautiful method of transportation. I was inspired by the cable cars plying Kjerag's snowy peaks.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You've been to Kjerag?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I will have been one day, but for now, the pictures in the newspaper will suffice.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: You should head back home already, young Djall.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What a strange ancestor... Why's he in such a hurry to leave Kazdel? And why bring Crownie along?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, there's no signal here...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Guess you're on your own, Nymph. Your big adventure begins here.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh thank goodness, she finally stopped.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It looks like she's not leaving Kazdel just yet.
In the distance, Crownie takes a deep breath, then yells a strange... incantation?
'Come on out, Suffering!'

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: 'Suffering'? Is that some kind of incantation?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It might be a name of a Sarkaz King. It wouldn't be strange for an ancient King to have a name like that.
If you insist, old buddy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heheh, long time no see.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: A-A Sankta?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: His plan involves a Sankta?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What the heck is he up to?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I can see you, little Djall.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No need to hide behind a rock, come on out.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Why's your apprentice being such a stranger?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: She's not. I believe there might be some misunderstandings at play here. She has been following me for quite some time now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If you keep wandering around with that brooch on, I think your face'll end up on an arrest warrant real quick.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I'll take it under advisement, Mostima.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: May I see the goods I ordered?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But of course.
Mostima gingerly places the box she is carrying between the two of them.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Three bolts of top-quality soft silk straight from Yan, just like you asked. Go ahead, inspect all you like.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: This... This is...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I can feel it...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: This subtle push-back when you press down on it, this suppleness, this pure white...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I guess he really does want to leave Kazdel. He's even got a bunch of supplies ready.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Huh? Where'd that Sankta go?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heya, little Djall. Nice weather today, isn't it?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: S-Stay back! I-I'm a caster! I've got really really super strong Arts!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ooh, what a coincidence. As it turns out, I'm a caster too. Makes us counterparts, don't you think?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But you're... I'm...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's fine, it's fine. You look reasonable enough, not the type to attack a defenseless Messenger like me for no reason.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'll take your silence as a good sign.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Crownie's gonna need a while longer to check out her haul, so I'll get some fresh air over here, maybe slack off a bit. Won't bother you at all. How's that sound?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: So, you're a Messenger?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Penguin Logistics. Guaranteed success.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wanna try some Lateran candy?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Thanks... Then, you can have some of this.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Baked dough from Kazdel. Shame it's gone cold... It's really tasty when it's hot.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Well, don't mind if I do.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: So... how do you know Crownie?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I probably shouldn't tell you. Client confidentiality and all. But... You sure you wanna listen to a Sankta story?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Who knows, I might weave a web of lies to snare your soul.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Go ahead. I can tell truth from lies.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: They say the Sankta are all awful and terrible, but... You haven't shot me with a gun yet, and you haven't tried to cut off my horns for a trophy on your belt.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Haha, alright. I'll start talking, then.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hmm... Where to begin?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A few years ago, on a job in Ursus, I ran into a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Apparently, she couldn't stand life at home and decided to wander across the lands. By the time I met her, she had just managed to find a path she wanted to follow.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ursus has real strict controls on a lot of things, so that Sarkaz needed people like us to get her the stuff she wanted.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Was Crownie a designer in Ursus?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A designer? Heh, an Ursine hiring a Sarkaz to be an assistant is already a super-nice Ursine.

spans.text: A designer? Heh, an Ursine hiring a Sarkaz to be an

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Y'know, the fashion brand that hired her was actually founded by a Sarkaz, but it got so crazy-popular in Ursus most people think it's local.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Even that fashion freak over there thought so at first. Anyway, she got the cold shoulder in Ursus, so after a bunch more wandering, she made her way back here.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: She must have made a lot of money before she came back.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Money? Hehe, shame I have to say it, but she's barely got two coins to rub together.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: When you look at her, well, you're seeing everything she's got, in a way.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: The silk's perfect, Mostima!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Then why's she buying cloth? I've seen where she lives, and the people around her. Maybe she's skipping meals to afford all this expensive stuff...?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Maybe she predicted that the Furnace would explode, and wanted the revenant to latch onto the fabric? No, that doesn't make any sense...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wowee, that sounds serious.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I have no clue what you're talking about, but we should probably head on over. C'mon.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Need anything else, Crownie?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: My thanks, Mostima. You must have been through a lot, coming all this way.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Nah, just doing my job.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: As for further work, I would like some fabric from Sargon. I presume I will need to give full payment in advance, just as before?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I mean, sure, but I don't think you'll be needing my services much longer.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: What ever do you mean? Is your company changing its modus operandi?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No, don't get the wrong idea here.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What I mean is—

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: This sort of stuff will be sold in Kazdel soon enough, so you won't need Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Is that so...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The number of caravans going in and out of Kazdel has doubled several times over. The folks at Rhodes Island have also helped set up a few connections for the city.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You'll probably have a place you can get imported goods before long.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: So you're saying... I will be able to sell my Kazdelian souvenirs?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Your what?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Crystal balls, cups... You know, souvenirs you'd get on a trip. Not that different to the ones you see in other countries, they're just Kazdel-themed.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But who would want to go on vacation to Kazdel? We don't really have any good sightseeing spots.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I wouldn't mind, to be honest. Walk around, see your Soul Furnace, roam the streets, and there's that 'Temple of Knowledge'... That's in Kazdel, right?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: *sigh* Shame I won't get the chance. Your idea's not bad, though. You should talk to the merchants. They might want to buy some souvenirs to show off back home.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I'll bear it in mind. My thanks. As for you, young Djall...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Call me Nymph.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Let us go, Madam Nymph. We should hurry on home.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Okay. Well, see you, Sankta Messenger lady!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ciao. If you ever need anything, remember to call Penguin Logistics. Crownie's got our contact.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Phew... Shouldn't you have popped out too, 'Suffering'? Or is it 'Mad Bomber' these days?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Have you lost your mind? Coming to Kazdel just for a delivery?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If you get caught by the Sarkaz, there's no way you're making it out alive.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She's an old customer. Not wise to refuse a request.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What, worried about me?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Supervising you is my job. We're going back right now. Immediately.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Alright, alright. Not like there's anywhere to run in this wasteland anyway. Say, why don't we go have some fun in Kazdel for a day?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: (Raises weapon) ...Start walking.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: *sigh* It's so hard to get through to you.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Welcome to my humble abode.
After an entire day of walking, Nymph and Crownie are back in front of the warehouse where they first spoke.
The place that Nymph assumed the revenant compelled Crownie to go to avoid the crowd.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (She really does live here.)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (There's a bed, a workbench, some clothes hung up, a corner full of junk. She's missing a lot of basic furniture.)

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: When you look at her, well, you're seeing everything she's got, in a way.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Please, make yourself at home.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Do you need help, Crownie?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: No. I can handle things on my own.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That cloth you bought is really expensive.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: A mere several months' worth of food, hardly important.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Hmm, this place is ill-suited for a brooch. If I use this cloth to make a matching necktie or cravat...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Madam Nymph.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: You wanted this brooch, did you not?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? Yeah.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But didn't you—

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Take it. I no longer have need of it.
A heavy stillness emanates from the brooch, and Nymph cannot stop herself from shivering. She quickly throws the fragment-embedded jewelry into her box.
This whole time, the revenant fragment seems to have done nothing other than latch onto the brooch.
No commanding strange creations, no instigating arguments in a crowd.
When he was in the palm of her hand, she even felt some fury and frustration coming from him, like...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: ...Talking to a burdenbeast?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Pardon?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, no, it's nothing, just a funny idea that popped into my head... Are you feeling alright, Crownie?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Thank you for your concern, but I've been fit as a fiddle this entire time.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: (She doesn't sound any different from earlier. Has she really recovered from it?)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: If there's anything I can do to help, don't hesitate to ask.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Hmm... As it were, Madam Nymph, I do have a presumptuous request.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Just Nymph is fine, no need to be so formal.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Very well then, Nymph. Could you come here for a moment?
Nymph looks at the clothes atop Crownie's workbench. They appear to be a suit, but not in Crownie's size.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Could you try this on?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Me?
Crownie whips out a tape measure, rapidly taking Nymph's measurements while muttering strings of numbers to herself.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: It should fit you. Give it a try.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Aren't these clothes really expensive? I'm scared I'll—

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Don't worry. It's not finished yet.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Alright, then.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: H-How do I look?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Beautiful.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: How is the fit? Are the cuffs too tight? Too loose? Anywhere that feels particularly awkward?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No, it's a perfect fit...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Are you making these clothes for a friend?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: No. It is a gift to myself.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: This outfit's creation is my dream, but alas, I am still unable to realize it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I think it's pretty much perfect already.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Far from it, I'm afraid. The cuffs still need embellishment, the accessories still need matching. All in all, still rather crude...

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: You may take it off now, Nymph. My thanks.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But why would you make an outfit you can't wear?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Because its revelation gave my life direction.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I wanted to distinguish my life from those of others, but I too love this city. And so, I called attention to myself through a multitude of methods, old Sarkaz tricks all. I'm sure you'll understand where I'm coming from.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: In the end, I was driven away from Kazdel, set adrift in the wilds.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I was offered menial work in Ursus. At first, it was only my survival instinct that spurred me to accept.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: But I found myself rather suited to deft needlework. More importantly, I obtained a designer's manuscript.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: A Sarkaz designer from Kazdel. Kazdel, designer. Never had I thought those two words could fit together.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Were these clothes in that manuscript?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: They were. It was a heavily damaged book, and much information was lost, save for a note reading 'for AM' and the framework of this suit. Naught else remained.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Despite the damage, it provoked an emotion I had never felt before.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: In order to understand it, I took up tailoring, alongside the crafting of many other knick-knacks.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: As it happened, Kazdel had forgotten me by that point. And so I returned, under a new identity.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Kazdel has changed, just as I have. It's a more tolerant city these days. Even a stuck-out nail such as I can find a stage here.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Is that why you made stuff you can't sell?

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: They are souvenirs. There will come a day that Kazdel will entertain visitors from all across Terra. This, I do believe.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: Though I am merely testing the waters on a whim, if other places can enjoy something, then why not Kazdel? We are not so different from them.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: It could be a suit of fashionable clothes, a set of baubles for tourists, or even... a way of life. The pursuit of beauty.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You might be thinking too far ahead. I've never even dreamed of Kazdel being a tourist attraction!

spans.text: You might be thinking too far ahead. I've never even
of Kazdel being a tourist attraction!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You're right that the city has changed lately, though. There's lots of people walking around, and it's real lively these days. Completely different from before.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Did you see the fireworks a few nights ago? They were so pretty! Maybe the Furnace got a bit too happy and lively, and that's why it fired them off.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nymph, what's going on?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Everything's fine now, Ermi. Ran into some trouble while I was trying to get the fragment, but they're all taken care of.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Good to hear. I was helping the old— *cough* aiding my master in some research on phylactery, so I didn't catch your calls. Terribly sorry about that.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's fine, I've covered most of the city by now. There's just one newly-repaired residential district left to check. I might be finished by tomorrow, so you'd better get that reward ready!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Once you're done, come right over and it's all yours. You're a lifesaver.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I'll be turning in early tonight. Goodbye.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sure, see you soon, Ermi.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Well, I won't trouble you any longer, Crownie. If anything comes up, remember to come find me. Here's my contact.

steps.name: Crownie
steps.text: I will, thank you. Good night, Nymph.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Good night.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hah... I'm so tired...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I never got to eat any of that baked dough I bought this morning.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *munch*

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hmm... I think if I warm it up once I get home, it'll taste a lot better.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Pohl! How did you find me?

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: You walked up to the city gates and flew off the walls. The information brokers've been chatting about you pretty much all day.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Did you find anything?

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: Nope. No signs of fragment influence around the Military Commission garrison or settlement.

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: You found something yourself, didn't you?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Yeah! Look! The fragment I found today is super pretty! It's like a gem!

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: It's a piece of glass from inside the furnace, looks like. You're right though, that color is really distinctive.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: The lady who gave it to me was really distinctive too!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Today's been real hard on me, though. I was running around all day, and now I'm hungry and tired, haaah...

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: Go home and get some rest already. Just one residential district left to check. Gotta do all we can to get everything wrapped up tomorrow.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: Damn, you're so tired you nearly smacked your head against the wall... Fine, I'll walk you home.

steps.name: Pohl
steps.text: Don't fall asleep just yet. Tell me about this 'distinctive lady' you met.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sure... I went to the market this morning to buy...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Some baked dough, which smelled real nice...
